spells.name: Big Kick
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and kicks them 2 tiles back.

spells.name: Cryptid Vanish
spells.desc: Was it real? The photo's blurry... Teleport 2 tiles, invisible 2 turns.

spells.name: Entangling Roots
spells.desc: The ground remembers what it grew. Deals MEDIUM magic damage to All Enemies in a 3×3 and Roots them for a round.

spells.name: Sasquatch Smash
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. The photo would have been blurry anyway. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

spells.name: Herbal Remedy
spells.desc: Restores a BIG amount of HP to a Single Ally and cleanses 2 debuffs.

spells.name: Thornlash
spells.desc: A bramble whip wraps the legs. WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy and Roots it for 1 round.

spells.name: Love Bite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Lowers the target's DEF by 1 stage.

spells.name: Nimble Dodge
spells.desc: Gracefully dash 3 tiles away and vanish for 1 turn. Perfect evasive maneuver. Needs 2 rounds between dodges.

spells.name: Meow
spells.desc: An adorable, disarming meow. All enemies within 2 tiles have their DEF lowered for 3 rounds. Deals no damage.

spells.name: Ninefold Scratch
spells.desc: Nine lives, nine scratches. Deals SEVERE physical damage to a Single Enemy across 9 hits.

spells.name: Sprint
spells.desc: Go. Runs to an empty tile up to 3 away, in any direction.
Dashes through the battlefield. Applies Stagger. The caster charges into melee first.
spells.name: Ram Charge
Transform
spells.desc: Stand up into the combat platform: −3 SPD, +1 DEF and +2 M DEF stages, +2 RNG. Or fold back down.

spells.name: Hydraulic Crush
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to Jammed or Staggered targets.

spells.name: Vehicular Manslaughter
spells.desc: It was an accident. Four times. Drives through every enemy in the lane for HEAVY physical damage. Deals bonus damage to Discorded targets.

spells.name: Hydraulic Punch
spells.desc: Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets with Jammed. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.

spells.name: Exhaust Cloud
spells.desc: Pump toxic exhaust in a 3x3 cloud for 2 turns. Enemies inside fall into Discord (ATK and DEF lowered).

spells.name: Swing Door
spells.desc: Mind the door. Shoot a door onto an EMPTY tile beside an enemy within 3 — the hinge — and it swings through them: WEAK physical damage, Staggered, and they are pushed 2 tiles straight away from the hinge. Pick the hinge on the far side and you pick where they land.

spells.name: Breaking and Entering
spells.desc: Nobody said the door had to be yours. Shoot a door down beside an enemy within 4 tiles you can see and come through it: WEAK physical damage, always a rear attack.

spells.name: Underdog Spirit
spells.desc: Nobody believed in you. Good. Raises the caster's ATK by 2 stages and cleanses a debuff.

spells.name: Drop In
spells.desc: Uninvited. Shoot a door into the air over an enemy within 5 tiles you can see and drop out of it onto them: HEAVY physical damage, always a rear attack, worse on a Staggered target, and every other enemy beside the landing takes WEAK physical damage from the slam.

spells.name: Elbow Grease
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. No tricks, no magic — just honest work.

spells.name: Air Mail
spells.desc: Return to sender. Shoot a door at an enemy within 4 tiles: they go in, and a door opens three storeys over their head for them to fall out of. MEDIUM physical damage from the landing, flyers are grounded, the target is Staggered.

spells.name: Door Dash
spells.desc: Take the short cut. Shoot a door onto an empty tile within 5, step into a door at your feet and out of that one. No damage, no opportunity strikes — you were never in between.

spells.name: Quake
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY physical damage to All Enemies around the caster (AOE). Slowed targets take it worse. Reshapes the ground on impact.

spells.name: Clay Crush
spells.desc: Squeeze. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy beside you. Deals bonus damage to Rooted targets. Upgrades: Ricochet (The hit bounces once to the weakest enemy within 2 tiles of the victim for half damage).

spells.name: Ground Slam
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies in an AOE. Applies Slow.

spells.name: Stonefall
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Applies Stagger. Fires through cover.

spells.name: Emet
spells.desc: The word on the brow glows: truth. The golem gains a 120-point barrier and +1 DEF stage. Cooldown: 2 rounds.

spells.name: Heal
spells.desc: Restores a LARGE amount of HP to a Single Ally. Heals more on allies below 40% HP.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.desc: Consecrate a 3x3 area for 3 rounds. Allies standing in it heal each round.

spells.name: Miracle
spells.desc: Swap places with an ally within 4 tiles; the ally arrives healed for a MEDIUM amount of HP.

spells.name: Healing Horn
spells.desc: The horn laid on the wound. Heals a Single Ally within 2 a MEDIUM amount and gives them Regen for 2 rounds. Cooldown: 2 rounds. Upgrades: Long Reach (+1 range).

spells.name: Horn Toss
spells.desc: A true toss. Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy and throws it 3 tiles whichever way you pick (click the target, then a tile beside it). Slamming into something hurts more. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

spells.name: Protect
spells.desc: Empowers a Single Ally. Applies Protect. Cooldown: 3 rounds.

spells.name: Bath Salts
spells.desc: FLORIDA MAN FOUND NAKED ON OVERPASS. Raises his ATK and SPD by 2 stages and he Regenerates for 2 rounds. Only on the rounds it is the headline.

spells.name: Nimble Dodge
spells.desc: Gracefully dash 3 tiles away and vanish for 1 turn. Perfect evasive maneuver. Needs 2 rounds between dodges. Upgrades: Efficient (−10 MP (never below 5)).

spells.name: Curb Stomp
spells.desc: Put an adjacent enemy on the pavement and stomp. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and leaves a Grievous Wound — healing on them is halved for 2 rounds. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

spells.name: No Mercy
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. Executes a target below 25% HP outright. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

spells.name: Skull Crack
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Applies Silence.

spells.name: Sprint
spells.desc: Go. Runs to an empty tile up to 3 away, in any direction.

spells.name: Dragonfire
spells.desc: Exhale a roaring column of dragonfire, dealing HEAVY magic damage to All Enemies in a line. Deals bonus damage to Burning targets.

spells.name: Gale
spells.desc: One long breath down the row. MEDIUM magic damage to everything in the line, and all of it three tiles further from you.

spells.name: Updraft
spells.desc: Give them the sky. One ally is Levitating for 2 rounds — flight, the high-ground bonus, and a little more reach. +1 MOV for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Grapple
spells.desc: Fire a grappling hook at a tile up to 5 away, in any direction, and reel yourself along the rope — onto an open tile, or up beside a wall, a door or a unit. No damage.

spells.name: Take Aim
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. Ignores DEF. Deals bonus damage to Stunned or Rooted targets. Marks the target: the hit lands at the end of the round, but only while your team can still see them. A target at 15% HP or less is killed outright.

spells.name: Love Bite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Lowers the target's DEF by 1 stage.

spells.name: Nimble Dodge
spells.desc: Gracefully dash 3 tiles away and vanish for 1 turn. Perfect evasive maneuver. Needs 2 rounds between dodges.

spells.name: Meow
spells.desc: An adorable, disarming meow. All enemies within 2 tiles have their DEF lowered for 3 rounds. Deals no damage.

spells.name: Ninefold Scratch
spells.desc: Nine lives, nine scratches. Deals SEVERE physical damage to a Single Enemy across 9 hits.

spells.name: Sprint
spells.desc: Go. Runs to an empty tile up to 3 away, in any direction.
Dashes through the battlefield. Applies Stagger. The caster charges into melee first.
spells.name: Ram Charge
Transform
spells.desc: Stand up into the combat platform: −3 SPD, +1 DEF and +2 M DEF stages, +2 RNG. Or fold back down.

spells.name: Hydraulic Crush
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to Jammed or Staggered targets.

spells.name: Vehicular Manslaughter
spells.desc: It was an accident. Four times. Drives through every enemy in the lane for HEAVY physical damage. Deals bonus damage to Discorded targets.

spells.name: Hydraulic Punch
spells.desc: Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets with Jammed. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.

spells.name: Exhaust Cloud
spells.desc: Pump toxic exhaust in a 3x3 cloud for 2 turns. Enemies inside fall into Discord (ATK and DEF lowered).

spells.name: Swing Door
spells.desc: Mind the door. Shoot a door onto an EMPTY tile beside an enemy within 3 — the hinge — and it swings through them: WEAK physical damage, Staggered, and they are pushed 2 tiles straight away from the hinge. Pick the hinge on the far side and you pick where they land.

spells.name: Breaking and Entering
spells.desc: Nobody said the door had to be yours. Shoot a door down beside an enemy within 4 tiles you can see and come through it: WEAK physical damage, always a rear attack.

spells.name: Underdog Spirit
spells.desc: Nobody believed in you. Good. Raises the caster's ATK by 2 stages and cleanses a debuff.

spells.name: Drop In
spells.desc: Uninvited. Shoot a door into the air over an enemy within 5 tiles you can see and drop out of it onto them: HEAVY physical damage, always a rear attack, worse on a Staggered target, and every other enemy beside the landing takes WEAK physical damage from the slam.

spells.name: Elbow Grease
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. No tricks, no magic — just honest work.

spells.name: Air Mail
spells.desc: Return to sender. Shoot a door at an enemy within 4 tiles: they go in, and a door opens three storeys over their head for them to fall out of. MEDIUM physical damage from the landing, flyers are grounded, the target is Staggered.

spells.name: Door Dash
spells.desc: Take the short cut. Shoot a door onto an empty tile within 5, step into a door at your feet and out of that one. No damage, no opportunity strikes — you were never in between.

spells.name: Deploy Turret
spells.desc: Deploy a turret on an empty tile (1 AP). It paints the nearest enemy within 3 tiles with a targeting laser — the shot lands at the end of every round for MEDIUM physical damage. Max 2 per caster (a 3rd replaces the oldest). Enemies can destroy turrets.

spells.name: Heal
spells.desc: Restores a LARGE amount of HP to a Single Ally. Heals more on allies below 40% HP.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.desc: Consecrate a 3x3 area for 3 rounds. Allies standing in it heal each round.

spells.name: Miracle
spells.desc: Swap places with an ally within 4 tiles; the ally arrives healed for a MEDIUM amount of HP.

spells.name: Healing Horn
spells.desc: The horn laid on the wound. Heals a Single Ally within 2 a MEDIUM amount and gives them Regen for 2 rounds. Cooldown: 2 rounds. Upgrades: Long Reach (+1 range).

spells.name: Horn Toss
spells.desc: A true toss. Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy and throws it 3 tiles whichever way you pick (click the target, then a tile beside it). Slamming into something hurts more. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

spells.name: Protect
spells.desc: Empowers a Single Ally. Applies Protect. Cooldown: 3 rounds.

spells.name: Bath Salts
spells.desc: FLORIDA MAN FOUND NAKED ON OVERPASS. Raises his ATK and SPD by 2 stages and he Regenerates for 2 rounds. Only on the rounds it is the headline.

spells.name: Nimble Dodge
spells.desc: Gracefully dash 3 tiles away and vanish for 1 turn. Perfect evasive maneuver. Needs 2 rounds between dodges. Upgrades: Efficient (−10 MP (never below 5)).

spells.name: Curb Stomp
spells.desc: Put an adjacent enemy on the pavement and stomp. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and leaves a Grievous Wound — healing on them is halved for 2 rounds. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

spells.name: No Mercy
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. Executes a target below 25% HP outright. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

spells.name: Skull Crack
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Applies Silence.

spells.name: Sprint
spells.desc: Go. Runs to an empty tile up to 3 away, in any direction.

spells.name: Dragonfire
spells.desc: Exhale a roaring column of dragonfire, dealing HEAVY magic damage to All Enemies in a line. Deals bonus damage to Burning targets.

spells.name: Gale
spells.desc: One long breath down the row. MEDIUM magic damage to everything in the line, and all of it three tiles further from you.

spells.name: Updraft
spells.desc: Give them the sky. One ally is Levitating for 2 rounds — flight, the high-ground bonus, and a little more reach. +1 MOV for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Grapple
spells.desc: Fire a grappling hook at a tile up to 5 away, in any direction, and reel yourself along the rope — onto an open tile, or up beside a wall, a door or a unit. No damage.
